content.mission: Regulate safety in civil aviation and the operation of airports, provide air navigation services, and provide or coordinate search and rescue for aircraft in distress within the Singapore Search and Rescue Region.

sequence.label: Search and rescue
sequence.action: Provide or coordinate search and rescue services for an aircraft in distress within the Singapore Search and Rescue Region.

sequence.label: Investigation
sequence.action: Cooperate with the Transport Safety Investigation Bureau in its investigation of the occurrence.

sequence.label: Oversight
sequence.action: Exercise safety oversight of the aerodrome operator, including its rescue and firefighting services and emergency plan.

hand_offs.when: The aircraft in distress is at or near Changi aerodrome.

legal_authorities.instrument: Civil Aviation Authority of Singapore Act 2009
legal_authorities.power: CAAS regulates civil aviation safety and airport operation, provides air navigation services, provides or coordinates search and rescue for aircraft in distress, and cooperates with the Transport Safety Investigation Bureau.

review.notes: Archetype transport_operator is Assumed. The search-and-rescue procedure itself is not public; the step restates the statutory function only.
